Composition root remains default; no code movement merely to shorten Program and Api-owned Swagger config are separately recorded. Layer-owned registration considered with ARC023.
Specific repositories match default; approved aggregate-root boundary preference is additional but already explicit. Does not require one repository per table/aggregate unconditionally.
Technology-neutral query-expression ban and materialized/explicit-return restrictions broaden canonical EF focus; independent0170 explicitly registers this nuance.
Any generic CRUD contract prohibition exceeds named IGenericRepository, but explicit baseline preserves it and Infrastructure-only real-duplication exception.

Readiness/commit workflow, cache invalidation abstraction and bulk-operation consistency conditions already registered. Seeder's direct-context exception is in source and separately under persistence policies.
Explicit repository injection and concrete shared AppDbContext binding extend generic lifetime rule; both registered. No duplication of prior injection hypotheses.

Explicit transaction justified by several operations needing atomicity elaborates beyond single-save control; baseline0392 captures it and distributed-transaction limit. Default not universal prohibition.

Separate configuration classes, Infrastructure/Api migration command placement, provider retry preference and exact directory-based enforcement all extend general EF boundary but are registered with source-specific detail.
